about: Labels the MCP tests build into a small temporary repo from their pinned sources (sources/us/<setid>.json plus raw zips). Chosen from the full corpus so example query 2 (changes_between 2023-01-01..2025-12-31, section 43685-7, query 'suicidal ideation') has one example of every outcome. Expected values were cross-checked against an independent brute-force scan of the full US corpus on 2026-11-01.
